summary.text: Donna Brandenburg, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate and chair of the U.S. Taxpayers Party of Michigan, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Michigan to Jocelyn Benson.
She ran with Robert Donald Cowper II as her running mate.

paragraphs.text: Brandenburg was nominated at the U.S. Taxpayers Party convention on July 18, 2026.
She was also the party's candidate for governor in 2022, when she lost the general election.
She received 0.4% of the vote to Jocelyn Benson's 54.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
